title_en: Guide to the Graduate Thesis Examination Schedule for the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: This notice sets out the eligibility requirements, schedule, required documents and procedures for master's and doctoral thesis examinations in the 2nd semester of 2026, ending with final thesis submission in January–February 2027. The notice states that its contents may change and should be checked regularly.
applies_to: Master's and doctoral students applying for thesis examination in the 2nd semester of 2026 who have passed the Thesis Qualifying Examination (foreign language and major examination), meet the completion requirements and the degree conferral (publication) requirements, and, if they have completed coursework, are registered as graduate research students and have not passed their thesis submission deadline. Doctoral thesis examination (first and final examination) is open only to those who passed the preliminary examination last semester. Students taking the qualifying examination this semester should apply first and cancel if they fail it.

steps: Confirm your eligibility: check your qualifying examination result at MySNU [마이스누] > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험 신청] > Comprehensive Exam Result Inquiry [종합시험 판정결과 조회]; check completion requirements using the Completion Self-Diagnosis Checklist [수료 자가진단 체크리스트] and the Academic Guide [학사안내서]; and check the degree conferral (publication) requirements. If required, submit your TEPS or TOEFL score to the department office before submitting thesis examination documents.

Complete the online application on the department intranet (https://ece.snu.ac.kr/intranet/) between 21 September 2026 and 1 October 2026, 17:00, registering your official SNU email and entering all examiner information.

Submit the printed application documents (listed for master's or doctoral students) to the department office by the same deadline. The application is complete only after both the online application and the document submission are done.

Pay the thesis examination fee between 21 October 2026 and 3 November 2026, 17:00, via MySNU [마이스누] > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Thesis [논문관련] > Thesis Examination Fee Notice [논문심사료 납부고지서], by transfer to the virtual account or directly at the designated bank (exempt if your doctoral examination period extension was approved last semester).

Submit your thesis for examination: master's students submit to the department office staff (planned for November 2026), with [Master's, student ID, name, examiner's name] written in pencil at the bottom right of the front page; doctoral students deliver it directly to all five professors at least one week before the presentation.
Before your examination, collect refreshments from the department office (Building 301, Room 319); doctoral students must reserve their own examination room.
Before your presentation begins, fill in the result forms from the attachment yourself and hand them directly to the committee chair.
Submit the thesis examination result documents to the department office by 14 December 2026, 17:00 (master's) or 21 December 2026, 17:00 (doctoral).
If applicable, submit documents for withdrawal, extension or non-submission of the archival thesis by 14 December, 17:00, and any thesis non-disclosure request by 8 January 2027, 17:00.
Upload the final thesis (PDF only) to the library online between 15 January 2027 and 1 February 2027, 23:59.
Submit the Thesis Submission Confirmation [학위논문 제출 확인서] and the original approval page [인준지] to the department office between 15 January 2027 and 22 January 2027, 17:00.
translation:
Guide to the Graduate Thesis Examination Schedule for the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
Posted: 2026-09-15

※ The contents of this notice may change later. Please check it regularly.

1. [Eligibility to Apply for Thesis Examination]

1) Passing the Thesis Qualifying Examination [논문제출자격시험, 논자시]: foreign language + major examination
- Students taking the qualifying examination in the 2nd semester of 2026 should apply first. If you are judged to have failed the qualifying examination, contact the staff member in charge at the department office to cancel your application.
- Even if you have passed the major examination, you cannot print the fee notice [고지서] if you have failed the foreign language subject. (You can check this at MySNU [마이스누] > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험 신청] > Comprehensive Exam Result Inquiry [종합시험 판정결과 조회].)
- Since the 1st semester of the 2006 academic year, the English subject of the foreign language part of the qualifying examination has been replaced by a qualification recognition system. Students concerned (those who have not already been recognised as having passed) must obtain a TEPS or TOEFL score at or above the standard set by the College of Engineering, and submit that score to the department office, before submitting thesis examination documents (early March or early September of each semester).

2) Meeting the completion requirements [수료 요건]
- The SNU Completion Simulator [수료 시뮬레이터] system does not reflect the department's internal rules and is therefore not accurate. You must read the [Frequently Asked Questions] post – Completion Self-Diagnosis Checklist [수료 자가진단 체크리스트] and the Academic Guide [학사안내서] and check whether you meet the completion requirements.
- If you do not meet the completion requirements, it will be difficult to graduate regardless of whether you pass the thesis examination. Be sure to confirm that you meet them using the Completion Self-Diagnosis Checklist before the examination.

3) Meeting the degree conferral requirements (publication record)
* You must read the post on the regulations applying to 2026-2: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57963
※ Conference records for which only an abstract is submitted are eligible for recognition if the conference has a peer-review process. Have the record confirmed by a preliminary examination committee member, and submit a confirmation form including their signature before the thesis examination result documents submission date. The confirmation signature may be obtained after the preliminary examination. For detailed criteria and the confirmation form, refer to the guidance on the amended degree conferral regulations.

Master's: Submit documents proving that at least one paper in a domestic or international conference or in a domestic or international journal has been published or accepted for publication. Your name must be first among the authors excluding the advisor, and the advisor must be included as a co-author. Proof such as the publication record or an acceptance email must be obtainable before the result documents submission date. Mere submission of a paper is not recognised.
- Co-first authorship is not recognised for master's students.

Doctoral: Only papers or patents that include the advisor as a co-author and list the degree candidate first among the authors excluding the advisor are recognised. Both (1) and (2) below must be satisfied.
(1) At least one paper must be published or accepted for publication in an internationally recognised journal (SCI(E) level).
(2) At least one international conference paper or one domestic journal paper must be published or accepted for publication, or there must be at least one registered international patent.
※ Proof for (1) and (2), such as the publication record or an acceptance email, must be obtainable before the result documents submission date.
- Eligible to apply for doctoral thesis examination (first examination [초심] and final examination [종심]): those who passed the preliminary examination [예비심사] last semester.
- Notice 'List of conferences recognised as equivalent to international journals (SCI(E))': related notice (linked in the original notice; not included here).
- Notice on recognition of co-first authorship: related notice (linked in the original notice; not included here).
- Students admitted before 2008: one SCI(E)-level paper. Strengthened from students admitted in 2008: (1) one SCI(E)-level paper + (2) one international conference paper, domestic journal paper or registered international patent.

4) Registered research students / students whose thesis submission deadline has not passed
- Students who have completed coursework [수료생] must register as graduate research students [대학원 연구생].
- Thesis submission period after completion of coursework: 4 years for master's, 6 years for doctoral. (This does not apply to currently enrolled students; it applies only to students who have completed coursework.)
- Just before this period expires, you must apply for an extension of the thesis submission deadline or register as an over-period research student [초과자연구생]. (Refer to the related notice, linked in the original notice, and contact the department office.)

2. [2026-2 Thesis Examination Schedule]

1. Online application and submission of application documents: 21 September 2026 (Mon) – 1 October (Thu), until 17:00
2. Thesis examination fee payment: 21 October 2026 (Wed) – 3 November (Tue), until 17:00
3. Submission of thesis for examination: planned for November 2026
4. Submission of thesis examination result documents: Master's: until 14 December 2026 (Mon), 17:00; Doctoral: until 21 December 2026 (Mon), 17:00
* If you need an extension of the result documents deadline due to unavoidable circumstances, contact the staff member at the department office separately (you must contact them before the deadline).
5. Final thesis submission (including the approval page [인준지] and the Thesis Submission Confirmation [학위논문제출확인서]; if not submitted, you cannot receive your degree): 15 January 2027 (Fri) – 1 February (Mon), 23:59
6. Request for thesis non-disclosure approval: after the examination ends – until 8 January 2027 (Fri), 17:00

3. [2026-2 Detailed Thesis Examination Guidance]

1) Online application and submission of application documents
- Deadline: 21 September 2026 (Mon) – 1 October (Thu), until 17:00
(Notes)
- Students who withdrew from thesis examination last semester must go through every step of the thesis examination this semester, starting from the online application.
- If you wish to cancel after applying online, contact the staff member in charge by email.
- For examiner qualifications, refer to the attachment and to the internal rules on composition of the thesis examination committee → related notice (linked in the original notice; not included here).
- Submission method: Your application is complete only after you finish A. the online application (department intranet system, https://ece.snu.ac.kr/intranet/) and then B. the submission of documents to the department office.

A. Online application guidance
- Email: Register your official SNU email. All notices about the examination will be sent to your SNU email, so be sure to check it.
- Detailed major [세부전공]: Check your advisor's field. Reference page (linked in the original notice). (Biomedical Engineering [의용생체공학]: check 'Bio' [바이오].)
- Payment confirmation [납부확인]: When submitting the application, check the thesis examination fee box for now and submit.
- Examiner information: Check 'Member (On-campus)' [위원(교내)] for all SNU professors.
- External examiners: Personal information (including bank account number and resident registration number) must be entered. Refer to the attachment and enter accurate information.

B. Documents to submit to the department office
Master's:
1. Master's Thesis Examination Application [석사논문심사원]: print from the application page
2. Thesis Examiner Recommendation [논문심사위원 추천서]: print from the attachment
3. (If there is an external examiner) External Examiner Personal Details [외부심사위원 인적사항] (print from the application page) and Bank Transfer Application [계좌이체 신청서] (print from the attachment)
4. Research Ethics Compliance Confirmation [연구윤리 준수 확인서]: print from the attachment
5. Human Rights/Gender Equality Education Certificate (only the '2026 Seoul National University Human Rights/Gender Equality Education' certificate is accepted)
- https://helplms.snu.ac.kr > My Classroom [나의강의실] > Certificate Issuance (Korean) [수료증발급(국문)]
Doctoral:
1. Doctoral Thesis Examination Request [박사학위 논문심사요구서]: print from the application page
2. Thesis Examiner Recommendation [논문심사위원 추천서]: print from the application page
3. External examiner documents: External Examiner Personal Details (print from the application page) and Bank Transfer Application (print from the attachment)
- If you have appointed as an external examiner a foreign national with no affiliation in Korea, additional documents are required; contact the staff member at the department office.
4. Research Ethics Compliance Confirmation: refer to the attachment
5. Human Rights/Gender Equality Education Certificate (only the '2026 Seoul National University Human Rights/Gender Equality Education' certificate is accepted)
- https://helplms.snu.ac.kr > My Classroom [나의강의실] > Certificate Issuance (Korean) [수료증발급(국문)]
※ Following revision of the regulations and guidelines simplifying master's and doctoral thesis examination application documents, the advisor's recommendation letter for master's/doctoral theses and the doctoral CV have been removed from the required documents since the 1st semester of 2026.

2) Thesis examination fee payment
- Deadline: 21 October 2026 (Wed) – 3 November (Tue), until 17:00
- Payment method: MySNU [마이스누] > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Thesis [논문관련] > Thesis Examination Fee Notice [논문심사료 납부고지서] > transfer to the virtual account, or pay directly at the designated bank.
※ Virtual account payment is available from 09:00 on 21 October 2026 (Wed) until 17:00 on 3 November (Tue). During the payment period you can pay 24 hours a day on weekdays (closing at 17:00 on the last day).
- Students whose doctoral thesis examination period extension was approved in the previous semester are exempt from payment.

3) Submission of thesis for examination
- Who: Master's students. (Doctoral students must deliver the thesis directly to all five professors at least one week before the presentation.)
- Deadline: planned for November 2026
- Method: Write [Master's, student ID, name, name of examining professor] in pencil at the bottom right of the front page of each copy, and submit to the staff member at the department office.
※ If you submit individually to examiners, inform the staff member at the department office by email.
- Content: This is the thesis submitted before the examination; submit the thesis as written so far. There is no set binding format.

4) Submission of thesis examination result documents
Master's: until 14 December 2026 (Mon), 17:00
* If you need an extension due to unavoidable circumstances, contact the staff member at the department office separately (you must contact them before the deadline).
1. Master's Thesis Examination Summary [석사학위 논문심사요지], 1 copy
2. Publication documents:
1) Documents proving that at least one domestic or international conference paper or domestic or international journal paper, on which your name is first among the authors excluding the advisor, has been published or accepted for publication (mere submission and co-first authorship are not recognised)
- Recognised as a conference or journal paper only if the advisor is included in the author list (e.g. the part of the conference program book showing your name, publication confirmation, acceptance email, etc.)
2) A copy of the first page of the paper, 1 copy (highlighting required: your name / advisor's name / name of the conference (or journal))
3) For conferences, proof of publication or acceptance (including proof of presentation if the presentation has been completed)
3. Korean abstract, 1 copy
4. English abstract, 1 copy

Doctoral: until 21 December 2026 (Mon), 17:00
* If you need an extension due to unavoidable circumstances, contact the staff member at the department office separately (you must contact them before the deadline).
1. Doctoral Thesis Examination Result Sheet [박사학위 논문심사결과표], 1 copy
2. Doctoral Thesis Examination Summary [박사학위 논문심사요지], 1 copy
3. Oral Examination Score Sheet [구술고사 성적표], 5 copies
4. Ballot [투표용지], 5 copies
5. Recommendation for the Doctoral Outstanding Thesis Award [박사학위 우수논문상 추천서], 1 copy [only those applicable]
6. Doctoral Thesis Preliminary Examination Result Report [박사학위 논문 예비심사 결과보고], 1 copy
- Example (as written in the notice): A. preliminary examination date / B. first examination (or preliminary examination) date / C. first examination (or blank) date / D. blank (or first examination) 4. desired date and time of final examination
7. Publication documents:
(1) SCI(E)-level journal
- A copy of the first page of the published paper, 1 copy (highlighting required: your name / advisor's name / name of the conference (or journal) must be shown)
- Proof of publication or acceptance, such as an acceptance email
(2) International conference, domestic journal or registered international patent
- A copy of the first page of the paper or patent proof, 1 copy (highlighting required: your name / advisor's name / name of the conference (or journal) must be shown)
- Proof of publication or acceptance, such as an acceptance email or record of completed publication
- For international conferences, proof of publication or acceptance (including proof of presentation if the presentation has been completed)
8. Korean abstract, 1 copy
9. English abstract, 1 copy
10. Doctoral Journal Publication Checklist [박사학위 저널실적 체크리스트], 1 copy

Only those applicable:
1. Applicants for examination withdrawal / extension
- You must submit documents by 14 December (Mon), 17:00, referring to the attachment (you must contact the staff member in advance).
2. Change of thesis examiners
- Submit the Thesis Examiner Change Request [논문심사위원 변경신청서] before the public thesis presentation date (refer to the attachment).
- When changing an external examiner, additionally submit the External Examiner Personal Details and the External Examiner Bank Transfer Application.
3. Request for thesis non-disclosure approval (possible for up to 3 years)
- Submit the Thesis Non-Disclosure Application [논문 비공개 신청서] (refer to the attachment).
- Supporting documents are required, and it is possible only if one of the following three applies: (1) (domestic or international) patent application (filed or planned); (2) military secret; (3) a confidentiality agreement signed with a company.
- Your advisor's approval is required. Simple journal publication is not accepted as a reason.
4. Students not submitting the archival thesis
- Submit the Statement of Reasons for Not Submitting the Archival Thesis [보존용 학위논문 미제출 사유서] by 14 December (Mon), 17:00 (refer to the attachment).
- This applies to students who have passed the thesis examination and met the publication requirements and are postponing graduation by one semester, so the thesis examination result documents must be submitted this semester.
5. Three ways to postpone graduation by one semester (refer to the attachment)
(1) Not submitting the archival thesis (thesis examination passed + publication requirements met) – Master's: yes; Doctoral: yes. Points to check: result documents must be submitted this semester; you must register as a research student next semester; you must check your own thesis submission deadline.
(2) Extension of the thesis examination period (refer to the attachment) – Master's: no; Doctoral: yes. Points to check: can be extended only once; if you extended in the previous semester, you cannot extend again; you must register as a research student next semester; you must check your own thesis submission deadline.
(3) Withdrawal from thesis examination (refer to the attachment) – Master's: yes; Doctoral: yes. Points to check: you must register as a research student next semester; you must check your own thesis submission deadline.

5) Final submission of the thesis (approval page)
1) Final submission of the thesis (approval page) to the library
- Submission period: 15 January 2027 (Fri) – 1 February (Mon), 23:59. ★ Submission and corrections are not possible after the deadline, so please submit with time to spare.
- Only the full-text file is submitted online, with no printed copy (PDF upload only).
- Details will be announced in a separate post on submitting the final approved thesis (archival thesis) for 2026-2 (for now, refer to last semester's notice).
2) Final submission of the thesis (approval page) to the department office
- Submission period: 15 January 2027 (Fri) – 22 January (Fri), 17:00
- Documents: (1) Thesis Submission Confirmation [학위논문 제출 확인서]; (2) approval page [인준지] (original)

[Guidelines for preparing the thesis (approval page)]
1. The approval page must be signed/sealed.
- If a signature is a copy, you must submit proof (such as an email) confirming the examiner's intention to approve (proof is required for every examiner whose signature is a copy).
2. If students who were 'not submitting the archival thesis' or '(doctoral) applicants for examination period extension' last semester are graduating this semester, the submission date and approval date must fall within this semester. Dates from last semester are not allowed.
3. Approval page form: refer to the attachment.
4. Preparation method: refer to the attachment. Write February 2027 as the publication year and month on the outer cover.
- On the approval page, write as the submission date the year and month in which the deadline for submitting the thesis for examination (set in the examination plan) falls, and as the approval date the year and month in which the final examination deadline falls. For detailed examples, check this semester's thesis preparation guidelines.
5. The final thesis title must be identical to the title in the file uploaded to the library and the title on the approval page.

4. [Thesis Presentation Schedule and Refreshment Collection]

1) Master's public thesis presentation
- Schedule: planned for November (a survey of schedules will be conducted by email soon, followed by a notice).
- Documents required before the presentation begins: (Attachment – result documents) Fill in the Thesis Examination Summary (department, student ID, name, thesis title, etc.) yourself and hand it directly to the committee chair.
- Each examination lasts 25 minutes in total: 15 minutes of presentation, and 10 minutes for questions and examination, tidying the room and changing to the next presenter.

2) Doctoral public thesis presentation (first examination)
- Schedule: planned for November (a survey of schedules will be conducted by email soon, followed by a notice).
- Documents required before the presentation begins: (Attachment – result documents) Fill in the Thesis Examination Result Sheet, Thesis Examination Summary, Oral Examination Score Sheet, Ballot, etc. (department, student ID, name, thesis title, etc.) yourself and hand them directly to the committee chair.
- Please reserve the examination room yourself.
- The first examination date is a guideline. The presentation may be closed to the public, and it may be held after the end of November. However, two examinations in total (first and final) must be held.
- Because seminar students attend doctoral first examinations (public presentations), if the schedule or venue changes, be sure to inform the staff member in charge by email in advance. (Please post a notice of the new schedule and venue on the door of the original venue.)

3) Refreshments for the examination
- Students who have applied for thesis examination will be informed by email.
- Collect refreshments from the department office (Building 301, Room 319) before your examination date. (Supplies may run out temporarily, so please allow some time before your examination date when collecting.)

5. [Other]
- Guide to using the thesis similarity check program [new] (refer to the attachment).
- Check and comply with Seoul National University's 'Research Integrity Committee Regulations' [연구진실성위원회 규정], 'Research Ethics Guidelines' [연구윤리 지침] and 'AI Guidelines' [AI 가이드라인].
- Inquiries: department office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff member's contact details are given in the original notice.

Notes on completing the attached forms
- Keywords in the thesis abstract should be within 7–8 words, according to this semester's thesis preparation guidelines.
- Thesis non-disclosure requests are accepted only for the reasons in the College of Engineering thesis examination plan. The journal publication reason shown in the example on the common form is not accepted.
- The Doctoral Thesis Examination Request requires the advisor's confirming signature.

Attachments (7) – the contents of these files were not read and are not included in this translation:
1. 2026학년도 2학기 논문심사 계획(공과대학).hwp (2026-2 Thesis Examination Plan, College of Engineering)
2. 학위논문 작성 요령 및 양식.zip (Thesis Preparation Guidelines and Forms)
3. 학위논문 유사도 검색 프로그램 사용안내 및 연구윤리지침.zip (Thesis Similarity Check Program Guide and Research Ethics Guidelines)
4. 대학원 학위논문심사 및 학위수여에 관한 시행 지침.pdf (Implementation Guidelines on Graduate Thesis Examination and Degree Conferral)
5. 석사 신청서류, 결과서류.hwp (Master's Application Documents and Result Documents)
6. 박사 신청서류, 결과서류.hwp (Doctoral Application Documents and Result Documents)
7. 기타 양식.hwp (Other Forms)
attachments: 3. 학위논문 유사도 검색 프로그램 사용안내 및 연구윤리지침.zip
